notes: rk-5lzf (Tier A, LB5): the UNCONFIGURED state, made visible. This repo carries exactly notation-01's tracked-symbol usage and no profile, so Gate 9 enforces nothing — and the one thing it must never do is report that as a clean check. It emits a WARN and a `0/0 (no profile configured)` coverage line instead. L2 verbatim: 'Gates report coverage; a silent skip is a bug, full stop.' The state is distinct from a CONFIGURED-but-unusable profile, which reports its own different WARN naming the profile (unit-tested in test/gates/notation.test.ts) — collapsing the two would let a campaign that believes it is being checked read the same output as one that knows it is not.
